# HCMC Insider

> An independent English guide to Ho Chi Minh City (Saigon), Vietnam, written by locals for international visitors. It covers where locals eat (mostly Cholon, Saigon's Chinatown, in old Districts 5, 6 and 11), markets and old streets, and practical transport: Metro Line 1, free city buses (until 31 Dec 2026), airport buses and the river bus.

Every place page gives the English and Vietnamese name, address, directions, local tips taken from creators' video descriptions (hours, prices, what to order) and links to the original YouTube videos. Facts are checked against creators' descriptions and Vietnamese news sources; each page shows when it was last updated. Contact: hello@hcmcinsider.com

## Guides

- [Cholon Food Guide: Where to Eat in Saigon Chinatown (District 5)](https://hcmcinsider.com/guides/cholon-food-guide/): Where locals eat in Cholon (Chợ Lớn), Saigon's Chinatown in Districts 5, 6 and 11: noodle carts, dim sum, herbal duck noodles, sweet soups and Chinese-Vietnamese kitchens, with Vietnamese names, addresses and directions.
- [Best Noodle Soups in Saigon: Hu Tieu, Duck Noodles, Pho & More](https://hcmcinsider.com/guides/noodle-soups-ho-chi-minh-city/): Hu tieu, wonton egg noodles, herbal duck noodles, pho, spicy Hue beef noodles and more: local noodle shops in Ho Chi Minh City (Saigon) with addresses, directions and creator videos.
- [Dim Sum in Saigon: Where Locals Go in Cholon (District 5)](https://hcmcinsider.com/guides/dim-sum-and-wontons-saigon/): Where to eat dim sum, har gow, wonton dumplings and Chinese egg noodles in Ho Chi Minh City's Cholon, with Vietnamese names, addresses and directions.
- [Chinese Restaurants in Saigon Chinatown & Cholon Chicken Rice](https://hcmcinsider.com/guides/chinese-vietnamese-restaurants-cholon/): Old family restaurants in Cholon serving Teochew and Cantonese-style stir-fries, chicken rice and braised pork rice, with Vietnamese names, addresses and directions.
- [Vegetarian Food in Ho Chi Minh City: Local Chay Shops in Cholon](https://hcmcinsider.com/guides/vegetarian-food-ho-chi-minh-city/): Local vegetarian (chay) noodle shops and kitchens in Ho Chi Minh City and Cholon, with Vietnamese names, addresses, directions and creator videos.
- [Chè in Saigon: Where to Try Vietnamese Sweet Soup Desserts](https://hcmcinsider.com/guides/che-sweet-soup-saigon/): Where to eat chè, Vietnamese sweet soups and desserts, in Ho Chi Minh City's Cholon: old dessert shops with Vietnamese names, addresses and directions.
- [Cholon Markets: Binh Tay, Lantern Street & Saigon Chinatown Streets](https://hcmcinsider.com/guides/cholon-markets-and-old-streets/): Binh Tay Market, Hoa Binh and Phung Hung markets, Lantern Street and the herbal medicine street: what to see in Cholon, Ho Chi Minh City, with directions.
- [Ho Chi Minh City metro guide](https://hcmcinsider.com/guides/hcmc-metro/): Metro Line 1 stations, fares, opening hours and paying with a foreign bank card.
- [Getting around Ho Chi Minh City](https://hcmcinsider.com/guides/getting-around-hcmc/): free city buses in 2026 and how to tap in, airport buses 109 and 152, buses to Cholon and Cu Chi, Saigon river bus.

## Places

- [Thiec Market (Chợ Thiếc)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/thiec-market/): Local market, Cholon (District 11). Old Chinese community market in District 11, full of Chinese-Vietnamese street food.
- [Huy Ky (Huy Ký (sườn xào chua ngọt))](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/huy-ky/): Chinese-Vietnamese kitchen, Ho Chi Minh City. Chinese kitchen with nearly 60 years of experience, famous for sweet-and-sour pork ribs. Open 10am–10pm.
- [Dong Nguyen Chicken Rice (Cơm gà Đông Nguyên)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/dong-nguyen-chicken-rice/): Chicken rice, Cholon. Chicken rice institution in Cholon, running for more than 80 years.
- [Phung Hung Market (Chợ Phùng Hưng)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/phung-hung-market/): Local market, Cholon (District 5). Morning market in the heart of Cholon. Try sticky rice, steamed buns, Hong Kong-style rice rolls, chive cakes and old-school sock-filtered coffee. Busiest 6–9am.
- [Shan Dimsum (Shan Dimsum)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/shan-dimsum/): Dim sum, Cholon. Small but mighty Cantonese restaurant with good-value dim sum, sweet-and-sour ribs, coconut prawns and baked crab.
- [Lantern Street (Luong Nhu Hoc) (Phố lồng đèn Lương Nhữ Học)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/lantern-street-luong-nhu-hoc/): Lantern street, Cholon (District 5). Saigon's lantern street. It glows with thousands of lanterns in the weeks before the Mid-Autumn Festival.
- [8,000-dong Noodle Cart (Hủ tiếu gõ 8K Nguyễn Duy Dương)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/8-000-dong-noodle-cart/): Hu tieu noodle soup, Cholon. Tiny street cart selling noodle soup for just 8,000 dong a bowl. Open around 5pm–9pm at 20 Nguyen Duy Duong.
- [No. 1 Tan Da Antique Café (Cà phê số 1 Tản Đà)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/no-1-tan-da-antique-cafe/): Café, Cholon (District 5). Café filled with antiques and gemstones, where collectors meet to trade.
- [Phat Ky (Phát Ký)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/phat-ky/): Chinese-Vietnamese kitchen, Cholon. 40-year-old wok kitchen hidden in an alley at 11 Tan Hang. Famous for salt-roasted soft-shell crab and fried rice. Open 4pm–10:30pm.
- [Thiem Huy Noodles (Thiêm Huy Mì Gia)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/thiem-huy-noodles/): Egg noodles & wontons, Cholon (District 5). Started as a street cart nearly 50 years ago. A favourite for herbal duck noodles, at 455 Nguyen Trai.
- [Dong Giang Restaurant (Đông Giang Quán)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/dong-giang-restaurant/): Chinese-Vietnamese kitchen, Cholon. Long-running Chinese family restaurant in the Cholon area with a wide menu. Open 10am–9pm.
- [Mooncake Bakery, 187 Pham Phu Thu (Tiệm bánh trung thu 187 Phạm Phú Thứ)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/mooncake-bakery-187-pham-phu-thu/): Mooncakes, Cholon (District 6). Three-generation family bakery making affordable mooncakes. Best visited before the Mid-Autumn Festival.
- [Teochew Rice Shop (Tiệm cơm Tiều Châu 68 Phan Xích Long)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/teochew-rice-shop/): Chinese-Vietnamese kitchen, Cholon. Teochew (Chiu Chow) family kitchen at 68 Phan Xich Long cooking classic Chinese home dishes.
- [Cholon Braised Pork Rice (Cơm Giò Hầm Chợ Lớn)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/cholon-braised-pork-rice/): Braised pork rice, Cholon. Rice with slow-braised pork hock, at 529 Cach Mang Thang Tam, District 10.
- [Hoa Binh Market (Chợ Hòa Bình)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/hoa-binh-market/): Local market, Cholon (District 5). Historic Chinese market in District 5 for food and shopping, with fried noodle stalls at night and Ma Nghia's coffee.
- [Goat Restaurant, 239/1 Doc Lap (Quán dê 239/1 Độc Lập)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/goat-restaurant-239-1-doc-lap/): Goat dishes, Tan Phu. Goat specialist in Tan Phu with a huge menu of goat dishes cooked at your table. Open 10am–midnight.
- [Crab Noodle Soup 260 (Bánh canh cua 260)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/crab-noodle-soup-260/): Crab noodle soup, Cholon. Thick crab-and-shrimp noodle soup with pork hock; add fried dough sticks. Open 6am–9pm.
- [Herbal Duck Noodles, 328 Ba Dinh (Mì vịt tiềm 328 Ba Đình)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/herbal-duck-noodles-328-ba-dinh/): Herbal duck noodles, District 8. Budget lunch spot in District 8 for herbal duck noodles.
- [Kieu Ky Har Gow (Há cảo Kiều Ký)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/kieu-ky-har-gow/): Dim sum, District 1. Famous Chinese dumpling shop at 57 De Tham, District 1. Plates from about 35,000 dong. Open 1–10pm.
- [Phuong's Hue Beef Noodles (Bún bò Huế Phượng)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/phuong-s-hue-beef-noodles/): Spicy Hue beef noodles, Cholon. Spicy Hue-style beef noodle soup with beef, tendon, pork hock and sausage. Open early morning and late afternoon.
- [Vegetarian Noodles, 124B Ngo Nhan Tinh (Hủ tiếu chay 124B Ngô Nhân Tịnh)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/vegetarian-noodles-124b-ngo-nhan-tinh/): Vegetarian, Cholon (District 5). Huge pot of vegetarian noodle soup with napa cabbage and lotus seeds, served on the 1st and 15th of the lunar month, 6–9am. Expect queues.
- [Chinese Eatery, 147 Binh Tien (Quán ăn người Hoa 147 Bình Tiên)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/chinese-eatery-147-binh-tien/): Chinese-Vietnamese kitchen, Cholon (District 6). Packed, authentic Chinese breakfast spot in District 6. Open 6–10am.
- [Nguu Ky Noodles (Hủ tiếu mì Ngầu Ký)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/nguu-ky-noodles/): Egg noodles & wontons, Cholon. Egg noodles with wontons and congee with century egg and tofu skin. Open 6–11:30am and 3–9pm.
- [To Ky Satay Venison Noodles (Tô Ký – hủ tiếu sa tế nai)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/to-ky-satay-venison-noodles/): Satay venison noodles, Cholon. 60-year family recipe for satay venison noodle soup at 331 Minh Phung. Open 7–11am and 5–9pm.
- [Bitter Melon & Chilli Snack Stall (Khổ Qua Cà Chớn)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/bitter-melon-chilli-snack-stall/): Stuffed bitter melon, Cholon (District 5). Famous snack stall at Phung Hung Market, known for Chinese-style stuffed bitter melon and chillies in broth. Its cheeky name is part of the fun.
- [Man Tu Charity Kitchen (Bếp Thiện Nguyện Mãn Tự (quán chay 0 đồng))](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/man-tu-charity-kitchen/): Vegetarian, Ho Chi Minh City. Free vegetarian kitchen serving about 12 dishes. Lunch 11am–2pm, dinner 5–8pm. Please be respectful: it exists to feed people in need.
- [Nhat Tao Market (Chợ Nhật Tảo)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/nhat-tao-market/): Local market, District 10. Busy Chinese-Vietnamese neighbourhood market in District 10.
- [Pork Rib Noodle Soup, Bui Huu Nghia (Bánh canh sườn cây Bùi Hữu Nghĩa)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/pork-rib-noodle-soup-bui-huu-nghia/): Thick noodle soup, Cholon (District 5). Thick-noodle soup (banh canh) topped with giant pork ribs, made famous after a celebrity recommendation.
- [Huynh Le Noodle Cart (Mì Gia Huỳnh Lê)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/huynh-le-noodle-cart/): Egg noodles & wontons, Cholon. Chinese egg-noodle and wonton cart with a 31-year family recipe. Open 6:20–10am and 4:30–9pm.
- [Minh Ky Chicken Rice (Cơm gà Minh Ký)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/minh-ky-chicken-rice/): Chicken rice, Cholon. Popular, affordable crispy chicken rice in Cholon.
- [Wonton House 162 Ha Ton Quyen (Sủi cảo 162 Hà Tôn Quyền)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/wonton-house-162-ha-ton-quyen/): Wonton dumplings, Cholon (District 11). Wontons packed with shrimp and pork on Ha Ton Quyen, Saigon's wonton street.
- [Buu Loi Ky Vegetarian (Bửu Lợi Ký – quán chay)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/buu-loi-ky-vegetarian/): Vegetarian, Cholon. Chinese vegetarian noodles with fragrant satay broth and plant-based meatballs. Open 6am–1pm.
- [Binh Tay Market (Chợ Bình Tây)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/binh-tay-market/): Local market, Cholon (District 6). Cholon's century-old wholesale market. A busy, colourful place to see Chinatown trading life.
- [Sam Ky Herbal Duck Noodles (Mì vịt tiềm Sâm Ký)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/sam-ky-herbal-duck-noodles/): Herbal duck noodles, Cholon (District 5). Herbal-braised duck with egg noodles in District 5.
- [Thuan Phat Chinese Stir-fry (Quán Thuận Phát (món Hoa chiên xào))](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/thuan-phat-chinese-stir-fry/): Chinese-Vietnamese kitchen, Cholon (District 5). Chinese-style stir-fries and fried dishes in District 5.
- [Hao Hue Restaurant (Nhà hàng Hào Huê)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/hao-hue-restaurant/): Chinese-Vietnamese kitchen, Cholon (District 5). Chinese restaurant in Cholon, District 5.
- [Kim Khanh Phnom Penh Noodles (Hủ tiếu Nam Vang Kim Khánh)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/kim-khanh-phnom-penh-noodles/): Hu tieu noodle soup, Ho Chi Minh City. Hu tieu Nam Vang (Phnom Penh-style noodle soup) in central Saigon.
- [Tien Nhan Goat Noodle Soup (Hủ tiếu dê Tiến Nhàn)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/tien-nhan-goat-noodle-soup/): Goat noodle soup, Cholon. Unusual hu tieu noodle soup made with goat, in Cholon.
- [Yukii Desserts (Yukii Desserts)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/yukii-desserts/): Sweet soup desserts, Cholon (District 5). Chinese sweet-soup shop with pretty, photogenic desserts, including lotus-shaped sweets and a strawberry snow ice.
- [Dimsum 88 (Dimsum 88)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/dimsum-88/): Dim sum, Cholon (District 5). Dim sum restaurant on Nguyen Tri Phuong known for its trendy custard buns.
- [Herbal Medicine Street (Phố thuốc bắc Hải Thượng Lãn Ông)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/herbal-medicine-street/): Herbal medicine street, Cholon (District 5). Hai Thuong Lan Ong street, lined with traditional Chinese herbal medicine shops. Great for photos and smells.
- [Bao Binh Eatery (Quán Bảo Bình)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/bao-binh-eatery/): Chinese-Vietnamese kitchen, Cholon. Neighbourhood eatery in Cholon featured by a local TV news channel.
- [Co Lan Crab Soup (Súp cua Cô Lan)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/co-lan-crab-soup/): Crab soup, Cholon. Upscale crab soup with fish maw in Cholon, one of the pricier bowls in the area.
- [Cuu Long Restaurant (Cửu Long Quán)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/cuu-long-restaurant/): Chinese-Vietnamese kitchen, Cholon (District 5). Chinese-Vietnamese restaurant in District 5 praised by a local food vlogger.
- [Phuong's Noodle Shop (Quán Phượng (bún riêu, hủ tiếu))](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/phuong-s-noodle-shop/): Hu tieu noodle soup, Cholon (District 5). District 5 shop serving both crab-and-tomato noodle soup (bun rieu) and hu tieu noodles.
- [No. 7 Vegetarian (Quán Chay Số 7 Chợ Lớn)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/no-7-vegetarian/): Vegetarian, Cholon. Vegetarian restaurant in Cholon with a big menu, known for crispy vegetarian banh xeo pancakes.
- [Chuyen Ca Phe (Chuyện Cà Phê)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/chuyen-ca-phe/): Café, Cholon. Neighbourhood café at 70 Street 5, Binh Phu.
- [Sidewalk Noodles, 187 Huynh Man Dat (Hủ tiếu vỉa hè 187 Huỳnh Mẫn Đạt)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/sidewalk-noodles-187-huynh-man-dat/): Hu tieu noodle soup, Cholon. Cheap and tasty sidewalk hu tieu (around 30,000 dong). Evenings from 5pm.
- [Uncle Dinh 5 Snail Bar (Ốc Chú Đỉnh 5)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/uncle-dinh-5-snail-bar/): Snails & shellfish, District 7. Budget late-night snail and shellfish spot on Le Van Luong, District 7. Good for a casual evening with drinks.
- [Phuoc Vinh Satay Venison Noodles (Hủ tiếu sa tế nai Phước Vinh)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/phuoc-vinh-satay-venison-noodles/): Satay venison noodles, Ho Chi Minh City. Third-generation Chinese shop serving hu tieu with satay venison (about 95,000 dong).
- [Lam Thanh Sweet Soups (Chè Lâm Thạnh)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/lam-thanh-sweet-soups/): Sweet soup desserts, Cholon (District 5). Long-established sweet soup shop in District 5.
- [Vinh Phat Hong Kong Duck Noodles (Mì vịt tiềm Vĩnh Phát Hong Kong)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/vinh-phat-hong-kong-duck-noodles/): Herbal duck noodles, Cholon (District 5). Hong Kong-style herbal duck noodles at 866 Nguyen Chi Thanh.
- [Ai Hue Restaurant (Nhà hàng Ái Huê)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/ai-hue-restaurant/): Chinese-Vietnamese kitchen, Cholon. Classic Cholon restaurant for a Sunday dim sum feast.
- [Ha Ky Sweet Soups (Chè Hà Ký)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/ha-ky-sweet-soups/): Sweet soup desserts, Cholon (District 5). Chinese dessert shop with almost 40 sweet soups, running for over 30 years. Open 10am–10pm.
- [Thien Huong Crispy Chicken Rice (Thiên Hương – cơm gà xối mỡ)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/thien-huong-crispy-chicken-rice/): Chicken rice, Cholon (District 11). District 11 eatery known for crispy fried chicken over rice, Cholon style.
- [Luc Ky Noodles (Lục Ký (hủ tiếu mì xá xíu))](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/luc-ky-noodles/): Egg noodles & wontons, Cholon (District 5). Egg noodles with char siu pork, and noodles with chicken and dried fish, in District 5.
- [Dat Thep Pho (Phở Đất Thép)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/dat-thep-pho/): Pho, Cholon (District 5). Pho shop in District 5 with generous toppings and a side bowl of blood pudding and egg.
- [Lamp-post Sweet Soup (Chè Cột Điện)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/lamp-post-sweet-soup/): Sweet soup desserts, Cholon (District 5). Popular sweet soup (che) stall in District 5.
- [Tan Nha Eatery (Quán ăn Tân Nhã)](https://hcmcinsider.com/places/tan-nha-eatery/): Eat, Cholon. Small local eatery at Hoa Binh Market, recommended in a Facebook food review.
